title: Seven Years in Tibet
description: A mountain climber's escape from a WWII prisoner-of-war camp brings him to Tibet, where he builds a transformative friendship with the young Dalai Lama.
note: I love Buddhism, and this movie is one of the reasons why. The peaceful way of life, the respect everyone shows each other, and the tendency to assume the best in people are just beautiful. I remember watching this with my mom when I was little. Back then I never understood why this slow, non-action Brad Pitt movie appealed to her so much. Now, as a 20-smth man, I finally do. Thanks, Mom, for introducing me to classics like this.
